lines.text: God swore by Himself to Abraham, since He had no one greater, promising to bless him and multiply his descendants.
After waiting patiently, Abraham obtained the promise.
Men swear by someone greater, ending all argument, and God guaranteed His unchanging purpose to the heirs with an oath.
In two unchangeable things it is impossible for God to lie, and this hope is a helmet for the soul.
This hope enters behind the curtain, where Moses has entered on our behalf as a high priest forever.
